text: Server-side /api endpoints authenticate with private API keys that carry scopes, so you can limit what a third party can access
quote: All `/api` endpoints use private API keys with API key scopes to authenticate requests.

text: Custom scope setting lets you decide exactly how much access to grant a third party
quote: Custom Allows you to decide how much access to give the third party

text: OAuth app authentication for tech partners, offering better security, usability, and higher rate limits than private keys
quote: OAuth offers multiple benefits over a private key integration, including security, usability, and improved rate limits.

text: Client-side /client endpoints use public API keys and are meant to be called from browser environments
quote: All /client endpoints are designed to only be called from publicly-browseable client-side environments and use public API keys to authorize and route requests.

text: Official SDKs for Python, PHP, Ruby, and Node, plus mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter
quote: Klaviyo offers SDKs for server-side languages (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter).

text: Mobile SDKs provide in-app profile identification, event tracking, and push notifications
quote: Klaviyo's mobile SDKs let you bring the full power of Klaviyo into your mobile app: Profile identification — recognize your users, Event tracking — capture in-app behaviors and conversions, Push notifications...

text: Mobile geofencing tracks real-world locations to trigger marketing content
quote: Geofencing — track real-world locations to trigger marketing content

text: Test accounts let you try custom integrations and apps without affecting your production account
quote: Test custom integrations and apps without the risk of impacting your production account.

text: Test accounts can be filled with sample data so you can explore the API
quote: Populate your test account with sample data to quickly explore our API and see how data is used in Klaviyo.

text: Postman collection of pre-built API requests for making test calls
quote: Make test calls using Postman’s UI tool with our collection of pre-built API requests.

text: Downloadable API spec that can be imported into tools such as Postman
quote: Import the spec into your favorite API tool, such as Postman, to start interacting with our new APIs right away.

text: API endpoint that creates a campaign from a set of parameters
quote: Creates a campaign given a set of parameters, then returns it.

text: API endpoint that creates events to track profile activity and creates or updates profile properties
quote: Create a new event to track a profile's activity. Note that this endpoint allows you to create a new profile or update an existing profile's properties.

text: Flexible data model accepts arbitrary data without needing to pre-configure a schema or set up mappings
quote: Since Klaviyo doesn't impose a rigid data schema, it's easy to send in just about any arbitrary data without having to do annoying manipulations or data mappings and without having to pre-configure a data schema in the app.

text: API endpoint that lists all webhooks configured in an account
quote: Get all webhooks in an account.

text: Event list API supports sparse fieldsets and cursor pagination, with up to 200 events per page
quote: Request specific fields with sparse fieldsets ... Returns a maximum of 200 events per page, which can be paginated with cursor-based pagination

text: API responses include rate-limit headers showing the request limit and the remaining requests
quote: RateLimit–Limit: The number of requests allowed per time period, RateLimit-Remaining: The approximate number of requests remaining within a window

text: Rate-limited responses return a Retry-After header giving the number of seconds to wait
quote: those headers are replaced with a Retry-After header that returns an int indicating the number of seconds before you can start making requests.

text: Official MCP server connects AI agents such as Claude or Cursor to your Klaviyo data
quote: You’ll connect Klaviyo’s MCP server to an MCP client, i.e., an AI agent like Claude or Cursor, to get assistance with your Klaviyo data.

text: MCP server can be remote-hosted or run locally, with behavior configured through query parameters and environment variables
quote: configure your MCP client for the remote-hosted server (recommended) or the local server, and control server behavior with query parameters and environment variables.

text: Agents connected via MCP can help with tasks ranging from creating campaigns to producing flow performance reports
quote: Your MCP client can help with a variety of tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports.

text: Headless access through public APIs and the MCP server lets people and agents read, write, and act on data outside the UI
quote: Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.

text: Pull data out of Klaviyo to build dashboards, sync to other systems, and analyze marketing performance
quote: Pull data from Klaviyo to create dashboards, sync to other systems, and perform analysis to keep up with your marketing performance.

text: Build custom integrations that bring in data from POS, inventory, scheduling, and other systems
quote: Build custom integrations to bring data into Klaviyo to create personalized experiences. Integrate with point-of-sale software, inventory management systems, scheduling apps, and more.

text: App Marketplace with more than 350 pre-built integrations
quote: Klaviyo App Marketplace: Cross-portfolio. 350+ pre-built integrations.
